# Size guide

## How to measure your foot
Stand on a sheet of paper, mark the heel and the longest toe, and measure the distance in centimetres. Add 0.5 to 1 cm for comfort and compare with the size chart.

## Fit advice
Our running shoes run half a size small: order half a size up if you are between sizes.
Sneakers and boots fit true to size. Boots have room for thick socks.
Jackets have a regular fit. Choose one size up if you want to wear a thick sweater underneath.
Hoodies and T-shirts have a relaxed fit.

## Size chart
The EU, UK and US size table with foot lengths is in the size chart document.
